sources.title: webbrain-one/lfm3-vld-2b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM3-VLD-2B (Restored Language Head) is a hybrid multimodal browser decision model built using the Pegasus method (inspired by AveLabs/Qwen3.8-27B-Perplexing-Pegasus).

sources.title: WebBrain — Free Open-Source AI Browser Agent
sources.snippet: The Open-Source AI Browser Agent Free, open-source alternative to Claude in Chrome. Use any model, including local ones, so your pages never leave your machine.

sources.title: LFM3-VL-2B vs WebBrain Compass VLD Tiny v5 - WebBrain Blog
sources.snippet: We ran Liquid's new LFM3-VL-2B against WebBrain Compass VLD Tiny v5, our MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B fine-tune, on 4,857 BenchKit tasks per model the night LFM3 launched. LFM3 wins six of nine suites.
